evidence_boundary: Function bytes match the canonical inventory. Threshold bytes read through an immutable view of a fresh copied Ghidra project, whose before/after file hashes match. Stored original FileBytes are absent; full original XBE was not reauthenticated. No uploaded scripts or original game code executed.

constant_evidence.runtime_boundary: Only initial image bytes are established. Runtime immutability is not proved. The fixed-threshold helper requires those bytes to remain unchanged; runtime patching/mutation is excluded.

logical_operation.input: Already captured uint32 kind and raw binary32 word, plus valid writable byte storage. No host float argument.
logical_operation.kind_1: Raw DWORD store and raw-word result. No FP instruction or NaN canonicalization.
logical_operation.kind_2: Native CVTTSS2SI m32fp to signed-int32 result bits, then four-byte integer store. Current MXCSR state is retained, including native invalid/precision flags and DAZ behavior.
logical_operation.kind_3: Native FLD m32fp / FABS / FCOMP threshold / FNSTSW, preserving original instruction order and x87 state. TEST AH,5 parity logic returns and stores 0 only for ordered less-than; equal, greater or unordered return/store 1.
logical_operation.result: Logical final EAX DWORD only. The unchanged source void wrapper discards this result; no guest register transport is implemented.

original_register_contract.inputs: [entry ESP+4]=guest object pointer; [entry ESP+8]=raw binary32 word; object+0xc holds kind, object+4 is destination.
original_register_contract.capture_order: After PUSH ECX, load object pointer then kind. Read raw input on selected path before its output store. Logical API assumes input capture is already complete.
original_register_contract.eax: kind1 raw word; kind2 CVTTSS2SI result; kind3 0 or 1; other kind-3 modulo 2^32.
original_register_contract.ecx_edx: Kinds1/3/default restore incoming ECX and leave EDX unchanged. Kind2 overwrites the saved-ECX stack slot with raw input, so POP ECX returns that raw word; EDX becomes guest object pointer.
original_register_contract.not_implemented: Guest pointer/address mapping, original GPR/EFLAGS/stack cleanup, native caller ABI, aliasing with original guest stack/object loads before snapshot.

host_contract: GNU/Clang native x86 SSE and x87, fast math rejected. Valid output extent, byte-unaligned storage allowed. Kind2 requires all MXCSR exceptions masked. Kind3 requires all x87 exceptions masked and exactly the next push destination ((TOP-1) mod8) empty. Other paths need no free x87 stack slot. All tests are x86-64 Linux SysV; no 32-bit/other-ABI execution claim. Kind3 additionally requires the original threshold memory at 0x003a4fb8 to retain image word 0x358637bd.

compared_fxsave_fields.control_word: bytes 0..1, including exception masks, precision and rounding controls
compared_fxsave_fields.status_word: bytes 2..3, including sticky exception flags, condition bits and TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.abridged_tag_word: byte 4, mapping occupied physical x87 registers
compared_fxsave_fields.active_x87_stack_values: first 10 bytes of each 16-byte logical ST slot, only when its corresponding physical tag is nonempty using TOP
compared_fxsave_fields.mxcsr: bytes24..27, including SSE masks/rounding/DAZ/FTZ controls and all exception flags; kind2 may change flags.

excluded_fxsave_fields.instruction_and_data_bookkeeping: FOP bytes 6..7, FIP bytes 8..15, FDP bytes 16..23 differ with native instruction/data addresses; not guest-address emulated
excluded_fxsave_fields.inactive_x87_payloads_and_slot_padding: Empty-tag register contents are not logical stack values; bytes 10..15 of ST storage slots are padding
excluded_fxsave_fields.xmm_register_values: Host compiler may use XMM registers for integer/memory movement; guest SIMD register preservation is part of the excluded ABI bridge
excluded_fxsave_fields.mxcsr_mask: bytes 28..31 describe hardware capabilities rather than operation results
excluded_fxsave_fields.reserved_fields: Not defined logical operation state; comparison does not assert complete FXSAVE image or CPU-context equivalence

limits: No original executable execution, Xbox/full-game behavior, linkage or byte-identical rebuild claim.
No unmasked traps, fault recovery, MMIO or concurrent memory observers.
Source wrapper keeps its original void(int,float) signature and unresolved integer guest-address expressions; only the captured-word helper is executed/tested.
Caller declarations and existing wrongly typed callers are not repaired by this batch.
FIP/FDP/FOP differ because native instruction/data addresses differ. No full FXSAVE image or CPU-context equivalence claim.
The original FCOMP reads absolute memory each time. This fixed-threshold helper is equivalent only while that memory still contains 0x358637bd; no runtime immutability claim.

tests.additional: Integer-only output model, exact IE/PE/DE and comparison-bit anchors, full x87 stack on non-kind3 paths, byte-unaligned buffers, captured-word overlaps and exact guard-page extents.
tests.oracle: Independently authored monolithic native branch sequence, not extracted machine code execution.

gate_requirements: Mandatory original-source fixture SHA/Git-blob and exact reversal, historical ABS failure at O0/O2
Helper/oracle SHA pins and original narrow instruction windows
Native operation-only codegen rejects external calls at O0/O2
Unsupported architecture/SSE and fast-math compile negatives
Behavior negatives: wrong threshold/selector/byte width, raw-bit corruption, missing FABS, rounded CVT instead of truncation
FXRSTOR clobber regression; structural native FP sequence check
Optional private whole function/constant context verification; never required by public CI
